# ZodiacCalc — Chinese Zodiac Calculator

> Free Chinese zodiac calculator: find your Chinese zodiac sign by birth year or exact birthday, check compatibility between signs, explore the five elements, BaZi, Tai Sui, and yearly horoscopes. Based on the lunar calendar with exact Chinese New Year dates from 1900 to 2035.

Use this file to understand the site's purpose and available pages. All pages are in English and free to access.

## Core Tools

- [Chinese Zodiac Calculator](https://www.chinese-zodiac-calculator.com/): Find your Chinese zodiac sign by birth year or birthday, with lunar calendar accuracy
- [Zodiac Compatibility Calculator](https://www.chinese-zodiac-calculator.com/compatibility/): Check compatibility scores and analysis between any two zodiac signs
- [Five Elements Calculator](https://www.chinese-zodiac-calculator.com/elements/): Determine your Wu Xing element (Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water) and its meaning
- [BaZi Calculator](https://www.chinese-zodiac-calculator.com/bazi-calculator/): Generate your Four Pillars of Destiny chart (year, month, day, hour pillars)
- [Zodiac Year Chart](https://www.chinese-zodiac-calculator.com/year-chart/): Complete reference table of Chinese zodiac years from 1900 to 2035
